text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Alles Gute! Happy birthday to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you need help with? 
Pre-studying, review, making schedules... 
Just name it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... well, maybe not that... Hmm, a 
wish, huh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Idea sparked☆ A special wish, just for 
this special day♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Flash-san. Today, I want you to call 
me 'Falco'☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You said anything was fine, right? "Speak 
accurately"... wasn't that the rule?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes! Thank you so much☆
